description: Curated metadata for the parameters of Comet's comet.params file: what Comet's own -q output cannot say (display names, categories, help, enum labels, relationships, visibility, version ranges). Read by org.cometgui.params.comet.schema.MetadataLoader and by the documentation generator; format described in docs/developer/comet_parameter_schema.rst.

overrides.name: add_U_selenocysteine
overrides.shortHelp: Mass added to every selenocysteine (U) residue; 0.0 means no modification.

overrides.name: decoy_search
overrides.inlineComment: 0=no (default), 1=internal decoy concatenated, 2=internal decoy separate; .idx searches use the value the index was built with

overrides.name: index_search_type

choices.label: Not set: an index built on demand is a fragment-ion index (FI_DB), and Comet never warns

overrides.inlineComment: 0=create peptide index, 1=create fragment ion index; if .idx specified but not present
overrides.shortHelp: Used only when database_name names an .idx file that does not exist yet and is built from its FASTA: chooses whether that index is a peptide index or a fragment-ion index. -1, the default, means not set and builds a fragment-ion index. An existing .idx records its own type and a plain FASTA search has no index, so Comet 2026.03.0 ignores a 0 or 1 there and warns; any value other than -1, 0 or 1 is warned about and treated as -1.

overrides.name: spectral_library_ms_level
overrides.inlineComment: read by Comet 2026.03.0 but used only for a .raw spectral library, which it refuses
overrides.shortHelp: MS level of the spectral-library spectra. Comet 2026.03.0 reads this name (2026.02.2 did not), but its only use of the value is in the reader for a Thermo .raw spectral library, which this release refuses before it reads the level ("raw files as spectral libraries are not supported yet"), so a value given here has no effect on a search.

senseChoices.label: Cleaves on the N-terminal side of the cut residues
Cleaves on the C-terminal side of the cut residues

parameters.name: database_name
parameters.shortHelp: Path to the protein or nucleotide FASTA file to search, or to a Comet .idx index built from one. Comet has no default; the value -q writes is a placeholder.

parameters.name: decoy_search

choices.label: Concatenated: targets and decoys compete, one result per spectrum
Separate: targets and decoys searched and reported separately

parameters.shortHelp: Whether Comet generates reversed decoy peptides itself, and whether targets and decoys compete for one result per spectrum or are reported separately.
parameters.inlineComment: 0=no (default), 1=internal decoy concatenated, 2=internal decoy separate

parameters.name: index_search_type
parameters.displayName: Index type for an index built on demand
parameters.shortHelp: Used only when database_name names an .idx file that does not exist yet and is built from its FASTA: chooses whether that index is a peptide index or a fragment-ion index. An existing .idx records its own type and this value is then ignored. New in 2026.02.2.
parameters.inlineComment: 0=peptide index (PI_DB), 1=fragment ion index (FI_DB, default)

parameters.name: num_threads
parameters.shortHelp: Number of search threads. 0 uses one thread per CPU core; a negative value uses that many fewer than the core count. The NSLOTS environment variable, when set, overrides it.
parameters.inlineComment: 0=poll CPU to set num threads; else specify num threads directly (max 128)

parameters.name: peff_format

choices.label: PEFF: PSI-MOD modifications only, no variants
PEFF: Unimod modifications only, no variants

parameters.shortHelp: Whether database_name is plain FASTA or PEFF, and which PEFF annotations (modifications, amino-acid variants, or both) are searched.
parameters.inlineComment: 0=no (normal fasta, default), 1=PEFF PSI-MOD, 2=PEFF Unimod

parameters.name: peff_obo
parameters.shortHelp: Path to the PSI-MOD or Unimod OBO file that defines the modifications named in a PEFF database. Ignored when peff_format is 0; empty means no file.
parameters.inlineComment: path to PSI Mod or Unimod OBO file

parameters.name: compoundmods_file
parameters.shortHelp: Path to a text file of masses, one per line, used for a multi-modification search on 'J' residues. Empty means no file. Comet's parameter pages for 2026.02 do not describe it; this text follows the comment -q writes and the source.
parameters.inlineComment: path to compound mods mass file, one mass per line, for multi-mod search on 'J' residues

parameters.name: spectral_library_name
parameters.shortHelp: Path to a spectral library. Not described on Comet's 2026.02 parameter pages; the value -q writes is a placeholder. Empty, or a file Comet cannot read, means no spectral-library search.

parameters.name: spectral_library_ms_level
parameters.shortHelp: MS level of the spectral-library spectra. Caution: Comet 2026.02.2 writes this name with -q, but its own parameter reader looks for speclib_ms_level and its search code for spectraL_library_ms_level, so a value given under this name is ignored by that release.
parameters.inlineComment: ignored by Comet 2026.02.2, which reads speclib_ms_level instead

parameters.name: peptide_mass_tolerance_upper
parameters.shortHelp: Upper edge of the precursor mass window, in peptide_mass_units. Mass error is experimental minus theoretical, so this is normally positive.
parameters.inlineComment: upper bound of the precursor mass tolerance

parameters.name: peptide_mass_tolerance_lower
parameters.shortHelp: Lower edge of the precursor mass window, in peptide_mass_units. It is normally negative; a same-signed window is legal but deliberate (for example an open-modification search).
parameters.inlineComment: lower bound of the precursor mass tolerance; USUALLY NEGATIVE TO BE LOWER THAN 0

parameters.name: peptide_mass_units
parameters.shortHelp: Units of the two precursor tolerance bounds.
parameters.inlineComment: 0=amu, 1=mmu, 2=ppm

parameters.name: precursor_tolerance_type
parameters.shortHelp: Whether an amu or mmu tolerance is applied to the singly protonated peptide mass or to the precursor m/z. Ignored for ppm tolerances.
parameters.inlineComment: 0=MH+ (default), 1=precursor m/z; only valid for amu/mmu tolerances

parameters.name: isotope_error
parameters.shortHelp: Lets a narrow precursor tolerance still match when the instrument picked a 13C isotope peak rather than the monoisotopic one, by also searching the listed isotope offsets. The source accepts 0 to 7; the comment -q writes lists only 0 to 5.

parameters.name: mass_type_parent
parameters.shortHelp: Whether peptide (precursor) masses are calculated from average or monoisotopic element masses.
parameters.inlineComment: 0=average masses, 1=monoisotopic masses

parameters.name: mass_type_fragment
parameters.shortHelp: Whether fragment-ion masses are calculated from average or monoisotopic element masses.
parameters.inlineComment: 0=average masses, 1=monoisotopic masses

parameters.name: search_enzyme_number
parameters.shortHelp: Number of the enzyme, in the [COMET_ENZYME_INFO] table at the end of the file, whose cleavage rule generates candidate peptides.
parameters.inlineComment: choose from list at end of this params file

parameters.name: search_enzyme2_number
parameters.shortHelp: Optional second enzyme from the [COMET_ENZYME_INFO] table, applied together with the first. 0 means no second enzyme.
parameters.inlineComment: second enzyme; set to 0 if no second enzyme

parameters.name: sample_enzyme_number
parameters.shortHelp: Enzyme recorded in pepXML as the one applied to the sample; it does not change the search. Useful when the search enzyme differs, for example a non-specific search of a tryptic digest.
parameters.inlineComment: specifies the sample enzyme which is possibly different than the one applied to the search;

parameters.name: num_enzyme_termini
parameters.shortHelp: How many peptide termini must follow the search enzyme's rule: both (fully specific), at least one (semi-specific), or one named terminus.
parameters.inlineComment: 1 (semi-digested), 2 (fully digested, default), 8 C-term unspecific , 9 N-term unspecific

parameters.name: allowed_missed_cleavage
parameters.shortHelp: Maximum number of internal cleavage sites the enzyme skipped within one peptide. Not applied to a non-specific search. The comment -q writes gives 5 as the maximum.
parameters.inlineComment: maximum value is 5; for enzyme search

parameters.name: variable_mod01
parameters.shortHelp: One variable modification as eight fields: mass difference, residues (n and c for termini), binary group, maximum or min,max count per peptide, distance from a terminus, which terminus, required/exclusive, and zero, one or two fragment neutral losses. A mass of 0.0 leaves the slot unused.

parameters.name: variable_mod02
parameters.shortHelp: One variable modification as eight fields: mass difference, residues (n and c for termini), binary group, maximum or min,max count per peptide, distance from a terminus, which terminus, required/exclusive, and zero, one or two fragment neutral losses. A mass of 0.0 leaves the slot unused.

A mass of 0.0 leaves the slot unused.

parameters.name: max_variable_mods_in_peptide
parameters.shortHelp: Upper limit on the total number of variably modified residues in one peptide, across all variable-modification slots. 0 allows none.

parameters.name: require_variable_mod
parameters.shortHelp: When on, only peptides carrying at least one variable modification are analysed.

parameters.name: protein_modslist_file
parameters.shortHelp: Path to a text file pairing variable-modification slot numbers with protein accession substrings, so that a slot is applied only to matching proteins. Empty means no restriction.
parameters.inlineComment: limit variable mods to subset of specified proteins if this file is specified & present

parameters.name: fragment_bin_tol
parameters.shortHelp: Width of the m/z bins MS/MS peaks are stored in, which acts as the fragment tolerance. About 0.02 suits high-resolution MS/MS and about 1.0005 ion-trap MS/MS; narrower bins use more memory. Comet's minimum is 0.01.
parameters.inlineComment: binning to use on fragment ions

parameters.name: fragment_bin_offset
parameters.shortHelp: Where each fragment bin starts, as a fraction (0.0 to 1.0) of the bin width. 0.0 goes with high-resolution 0.02 bins and 0.4 with ion-trap 1.0005 bins.
parameters.inlineComment: offset position to start the binning (0.0 to 1.0)

parameters.name: theoretical_fragment_ions
parameters.shortHelp: Whether the fast correlation score also counts half of each neighbouring bin's intensity. Flanking bins suit narrow bins; the central bin alone suits very coarse (about 1 Da) bins.
parameters.inlineComment: 0=use flanking peaks, 1=M peak only

parameters.name: use_A_ions
parameters.shortHelp: Whether a-type fragment ions are considered when scoring.

parameters.name: use_B_ions
parameters.shortHelp: Whether b-type fragment ions are considered when scoring.

parameters.name: use_C_ions
parameters.shortHelp: Whether c-type fragment ions are considered when scoring.

parameters.name: use_X_ions
parameters.shortHelp: Whether x-type fragment ions are considered when scoring.

parameters.name: use_Y_ions
parameters.shortHelp: Whether y-type fragment ions are considered when scoring.

parameters.name: use_Z_ions
parameters.shortHelp: Whether z-type fragment ions are considered when scoring.

parameters.name: use_Z1_ions
parameters.shortHelp: Whether z-dot + 1 fragment ions, typical of ETD and ECD spectra, are considered when scoring.

parameters.name: use_NL_ions
parameters.shortHelp: Whether b and y ions that lost NH3 or H2O are also scored; Comet applies this to singly charged fragments only.
parameters.inlineComment: 0=no, 1=yes to consider NH3/H2O neutral loss peaks

parameters.name: fragindex_min_ions_score
parameters.displayName: Fragment index: minimum matched ions to score
parameters.shortHelp: A candidate must match at least this many fragment-index peaks to be scored by xcorr. Scoring more candidates fills out the score histogram used for E-values.
parameters.inlineComment: minimum number of matched fragment ion index peaks for scoring

parameters.name: fragindex_min_ions_report
parameters.displayName: Fragment index: minimum matched ions to report
parameters.shortHelp: A candidate must match at least this many fragment-index peaks to be reported; normally equal to or larger than fragindex_min_ions_score.
parameters.inlineComment: minimum number of matched fragment ion index peaks for reporting(>= fragindex_min_ions_score)

parameters.name: fragindex_num_spectrumpeaks
parameters.displayName: Fragment index: query peaks per spectrum
parameters.shortHelp: Number of most intense binned peaks from each spectrum queried against the fragment index. More peaks are slower; too few can lose correct peptides. Configurable from 2026.02.0.
parameters.inlineComment: number of peaks from spectrum to use for fragment ion index matching

parameters.name: fragindex_min_fragmentmass
parameters.shortHelp: Smallest singly charged fragment mass put into the fragment index. Comet ignores a value outside 200 to 2000.
parameters.inlineComment: low mass cutoff for fragment ions

parameters.name: fragindex_max_fragmentmass
parameters.shortHelp: Largest singly charged fragment mass put into the fragment index. Comet ignores a value outside 200 to 2000.
parameters.inlineComment: high mass cutoff for fragment ions

parameters.name: fragindex_skipreadprecursors
parameters.shortHelp: When off, Comet first reads every precursor mass in the inputs and indexes only peptides that could match one; when on (the default), it indexes every peptide in digest_mass_range.
parameters.inlineComment: 0=read precursors to limit fragment ion index, 1=skip reading precursors (default)

parameters.name: output_sqtfile
parameters.shortHelp: Whether results are also written as an .sqt file.
parameters.inlineComment: 0=no, 1=yes  write sqt file

parameters.name: output_txtfile
parameters.shortHelp: Whether results are also written as a tab-delimited .txt file. The comment -q writes offers 2 for a Crux-formatted file; the 2026.02.2 parameter code treats any non-zero value as 'write'.
parameters.inlineComment: 0=no, 1=yes  write tab-delimited txt file (2026.02.2 treats 2 as 1)

parameters.name: output_pepxmlfile
parameters.shortHelp: Whether results are written as pepXML. The CometGUI workflow requires it.
parameters.inlineComment: 0=no, 1=yes  write pepXML file

parameters.name: output_mzidentmlfile
parameters.shortHelp: Whether results are also written as mzIdentML, optionally with protein sequences.
parameters.inlineComment: 0=no, 1=yes  write mzIdentML file

parameters.name: output_percolatorfile
parameters.shortHelp: Whether a Percolator .pin file is written. The CometGUI workflow requires it, because Percolator rescoring reads it.
parameters.inlineComment: 0=no, 1=yes  write Percolator pin file

parameters.name: print_expect_score
parameters.shortHelp: In SQT output only, whether the E-value replaces the preliminary Sp score column.
parameters.inlineComment: 0=no, 1=yes to replace Sp with expect in out & sqt

parameters.name: print_ascorepro_score
parameters.shortHelp: Whether the AScorePro site-localisation algorithm is run on each top hit, and for which variable modification. Upstream calls it experimental outside phosphorylation; a confident localisation can replace Comet's top-ranked peptide.
parameters.inlineComment: 0=no, 0 to 5 to localize variable_mod01 to _mod05; -1 to localize all variable mods

parameters.name: num_output_lines
parameters.shortHelp: How many top-ranked peptides are reported for each spectrum.
parameters.inlineComment: num peptide results to show

parameters.name: scan_range
parameters.shortHelp: First and last scan number to search, inclusive. 0 for either end leaves it open; 0 0 searches the whole file.
parameters.inlineComment: start and end scan range to search; either entry can be set independently

parameters.name: precursor_charge
parameters.displayName: Charge range for spectra without a charge
parameters.shortHelp: Charge states to try for spectra whose precursor charge is unknown. A first value of 0 disables it; known charges are kept unless override_charge says otherwise.
parameters.inlineComment: precursor charge range to analyze; does not override any existing charge; 0 as 1st entry ignores parameter

parameters.name: override_charge

choices.label: Ignore known charges and use precursor_charge
Search only known charges inside precursor_charge
Keep known charges; for unknown ones use 1+ if nothing lies above the precursor m/z, else precursor_charge

parameters.shortHelp: How charges recorded in the input files interact with precursor_charge.
parameters.inlineComment: 0=no, 1=override precursor charge states, 2=ignore precursor charges outside precursor_charge range, 3=see online

parameters.name: ms_level
parameters.shortHelp: Whether MS2 or MS3 scans are searched (mzXML, mzML and mz5 inputs).
parameters.inlineComment: MS level to analyze, valid are levels 2 (default) or 3

parameters.name: activation_method
parameters.shortHelp: Searches only spectra acquired with this activation method (mzXML, mzML and mz5 inputs); ALL applies no filter.
parameters.inlineComment: activation method; used if activation method set; allowed ALL, CID, ECD, ETD, ETD+SA, PQD, HCD, IRMPD, SID

parameters.name: digest_mass_range
parameters.shortHelp: Lowest and highest singly protonated peptide mass considered; spectra outside it are not searched.
parameters.inlineComment: MH+ peptide mass range to analyze

parameters.name: peptide_length_range
parameters.shortHelp: Shortest and longest peptide, in residues, that is analysed. Comet 2026.02.2 analyses at most 50 residues.
parameters.inlineComment: minimum and maximum peptide length to analyze (default min 1 to allowed max 51)

parameters.name: pinfile_protein_delimiter
parameters.shortHelp: Text placed between protein names in the Proteins column of the Percolator .pin file. Empty keeps Comet's default, a tab.
parameters.inlineComment: blank = default 'tab' delimiter between proteins; enter a char/string to use in place of the tab; Percolator pin output only

parameters.name: num_results
parameters.shortHelp: How many peptides Comet keeps internally per spectrum, which bounds the range of the Sp rank. Comet raises it to one more than num_output_lines if needed.
parameters.inlineComment: number of results to store internally for Sp rank only; if Sp rank is not used, set this to num_output_lines

parameters.name: max_duplicate_proteins
parameters.shortHelp: How many proteins besides the first are reported for a peptide found in several; -1 reports all of them.
parameters.inlineComment: maximum number of additional duplicate protein names to report for each peptide ID; -1 reports all duplicates

parameters.name: max_fragment_charge
parameters.shortHelp: Highest fragment-ion charge considered; fragments are still limited to below the precursor charge. Comet enforces at most 5.
parameters.inlineComment: set maximum fragment charge state to analyze (allowed max 5)

parameters.name: min_precursor_charge
parameters.shortHelp: Spectra with a lower precursor charge are not searched.
parameters.inlineComment: set minimum precursor charge state to analyze (1 if missing)

parameters.name: max_precursor_charge
parameters.shortHelp: Spectra with a higher precursor charge are not searched. Comet enforces at most 9.
parameters.inlineComment: set maximum precursor charge state to analyze (allowed max 9)

parameters.name: clip_nterm_methionine
parameters.shortHelp: When on, a protein starting with methionine is also digested as if that methionine had been removed, and N-terminal modifications apply to the shortened form.
parameters.inlineComment: 0=leave protein sequences as-is; 1=also consider sequence w/o N-term methionine

parameters.name: spectrum_batch_size
parameters.shortHelp: Load and search about this many spectra at a time to bound memory; 0 loads every spectrum at once.
parameters.inlineComment: max. # of spectra to search at a time; 0 to search the entire scan range in one loop

parameters.name: decoy_prefix
parameters.shortHelp: Text prepended to the protein name of decoy matches. With an internal decoy search Comet adds it; Percolator and downstream tools use it to tell decoys from targets.
parameters.inlineComment: decoy entries are denoted by this string which is pre-pended to each protein accession

parameters.name: equal_I_and_L
parameters.displayName: Treat isoleucine and leucine as equal
parameters.shortHelp: When on, peptides that differ only by I versus L count as one identification, since low-energy fragmentation cannot tell them apart.
parameters.inlineComment: 0=treat I and L as different; 1=treat I and L as same

parameters.name: mass_offsets
parameters.shortHelp: Zero or more non-negative masses subtracted from each precursor mass before matching, for labels that fall off before fragmentation. Include 0.0 to keep the unshifted mass too. Empty means none.
parameters.inlineComment: one or more mass offsets to search (values substracted from deconvoluted precursor mass)

parameters.name: minimum_peaks
parameters.shortHelp: Spectra with fewer peaks (after clear_mz_range, before other processing) are not searched.
parameters.inlineComment: required minimum number of peaks in spectrum to search (default 10)

parameters.name: minimum_intensity
parameters.shortHelp: Peaks below this absolute intensity are dropped when spectra are read; Comet treats a negative value as 0.
parameters.inlineComment: minimum intensity value to read in

parameters.name: remove_precursor_peak
parameters.shortHelp: Which precursor-derived peaks are removed from each MS/MS spectrum before searching.
parameters.inlineComment: 0=no, 1=yes, 2=all charge reduced precursor peaks (for ETD), 3=phosphate neutral loss peaks

parameters.name: remove_precursor_tolerance
parameters.shortHelp: Half-width in daltons of the window removed around each precursor peak when remove_precursor_peak is on; must be positive.
parameters.inlineComment: +- Da tolerance for precursor removal

parameters.name: clear_mz_range
parameters.shortHelp: All peaks between these two m/z values are removed before searching, for example TMT or iTRAQ reporter ions; 0.0 0.0 clears nothing.
parameters.inlineComment: clear out all peaks in the specified m/z range e.g. remove reporter ion region of TMT spectra

parameters.name: percentage_base_peak
parameters.displayName: Minimum intensity relative to base peak
parameters.shortHelp: Peaks weaker than this fraction (0.0 to 1.0) of the base peak are dropped; 0.0 disables it.
parameters.inlineComment: specify a percentage (e.g. "0.05" for 5%) of the base peak intensity as a minimum intensity threshold

parameters.name: add_Cterm_peptide
parameters.shortHelp: Mass added to the C-terminus of every peptide. 0.0 means no modification.

parameters.name: add_Nterm_peptide
parameters.shortHelp: Mass added to the N-terminus of every peptide. 0.0 means no modification.

parameters.name: add_Cterm_protein
parameters.shortHelp: Mass added to the C-terminus of each protein's C-terminal peptide. 0.0 means no modification.

parameters.name: add_Nterm_protein
parameters.shortHelp: Mass added to the N-terminus of each protein's N-terminal peptide. 0.0 means no modification.

parameters.inlineComment: added to G - avg.  57.0513, mono.  57.02146

parameters.shortHelp: Mass added to every asparagine (N) residue; 0.0 means no modification.
parameters.inlineComment: added to N - avg. 114.1026, mono. 114.04293

parameters.name: add_D_aspartic_acid
parameters.shortHelp: Mass added to every aspartic acid (D) residue; 0.0 means no modification.
parameters.inlineComment: added to D - avg. 115.0874, mono. 115.02694

parameters.name: add_Q_glutamine
parameters.shortHelp: Mass added to every glutamine (Q) residue; 0.0 means no modification.
parameters.inlineComment: added to Q - avg. 128.1292, mono. 128.05858

parameters.name: add_K_lysine
parameters.shortHelp: Mass added to every lysine (K) residue; 0.0 means no modification.
parameters.inlineComment: added to K - avg. 128.1723, mono. 128.09496

parameters.name: add_E_glutamic_acid
parameters.shortHelp: Mass added to every glutamic acid (E) residue; 0.0 means no modification.
parameters.inlineComment: added to E - avg. 129.1140, mono. 129.04259

parameters.name: add_M_methionine

parameters.inlineComment: added to M - avg. 131.1961, mono. 131.04048

parameters.name: add_H_histidine
parameters.shortHelp: Mass added to every histidine (H) residue; 0.0 means no modification.
parameters.inlineComment: added to H - avg. 137.1393, mono. 137.05891
